baseline.method: Unmodified HFITS constant-convection thin-plate inverse on real HEPT thermal observations; standard method reference, not truth

balance_nrmse_definition: RMS residual of epsilon*1000*q minus the independently calculated storage+convection+two-face radiation-conduction balance, normalized by RMS balance RHS; all target times/pixels
reference_kind: unmodified standard method, actual flux truth unavailable
provenance: Independent original rerun identical, NumPy1.26 to2.4 port max7.11e-15 kW/m2; numerical tolerance is nonzero; see test/validation.md
